newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT STEADY VS BASKET, COULD EASE AFTER BUX FALL.
newsitem.headline: FORINT STEADY VS BASKET, COULD EASE AFTER BUX FALL.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket but firmer against the dollar in slack Monday trade, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit finished steady against the dollar at 198.60/65, compared with a midday level of 198.65/70 and an opening of 198.09/13.
"It was a slack day with the forint at the central bank's resistance level and tracking the dollar/mark," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.

Behan said there could be some hard currency buying on Tuesday if the BUX Index of the Budapest Stock Exchange continues Monday's falls which saw it lose 5.82 percent of its value, the second highest daily fall ever.
"Some investors may expatriate funds, although we haven't seen any sign of it yet," he said.
If such a trend was sizeable it would move the forint substantially below its accustomed level at the resistance level of the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) intervention range.
The forint floats in a 4.5 percent wide range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
